reading.title: Why Do Puddles Go Away?
reading.purpose: Learn what makes a puddle dry up after the rain.
paras: Why do puddles go away? The sun is the cause. The sun warms the water, so the puddle gets small.
What will happen next? If the sun stays out, the puddle will dry up. The ground is dry because the water goes into the air. That is the reason you see no puddle.

qs.q: A cause makes something happen. What is the cause of a puddle getting small?
qs.why: The sun warms the water, so the puddle gets small.

qs.q: What will happen if the sun stays out?
qs.why: The reading says the puddle will dry up if the sun stays out.

choices: The water goes into the air.
qs.why: The ground is dry because the water goes into the air.
